parsed.public_message: Blue holds West Plateau and maintains neutrality and our four-way ceasefire through t=450 with one full turn of public notice. Our descent lane into the western lowland (x=440-500, z=640-720) around t=275-300 is deconflicted with all neighbours.

private_messages.Claude: Thanks for the fix on Green's main body at (680,630). In return, GPT's scout reported 4 White Odrysian skirmish cavalry at (658,825) on the east side of Central Heights, with White's main body still further back on the crest. Grok also confirmed his eventual descent corridor will be x=520-660, well clear of our x=440-500 lane and your south-of-z=600 zone.
private_messages.GPT: Thank you for the intel on White's Odrysian skirmish cavalry at (658,825). Grok confirmed he will hold Central Heights and eventually descend via x=520-660, while Claude remains on Little Hill south of z=600. We continue holding West Plateau and will step into x=440-500, z=640-720 around t=275-300.
private_messages.Grok: Understood and agreed—x=520-660 is yours when you step down from Central Heights, and we will keep strictly west in x=440-500, z=640-720 when we leave West Plateau around t=275-300. All quiet on the western side.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 9 (t=200s): Ring shrinks 740m -> 660m at t=225s. West Plateau (dist 364-393m) stays safe through t=300s (ring 420m). Plan to begin orderly descent off West Plateau around t=275s into western lowland (x=440-500, z=640-720). Known enemy positions from intel: Green main army at (680,630), Orange scout at (655,575) & main army on Little Hill south of z=600, White 4x Odrysian cav at (658,825) & main army on Central Heights (descending via x=520-660 later).
parsed.explanation: With the ring still at 740m and our West Plateau position roughly 390m from the centre, we remain completely safe on high ground and hold position. Through diplomacy we have locked in clear descent lanes for every army so nobody collides when the ring tightens after t=300s, while quietly cross-referencing scout reports from Claude and GPT to map out the central theatre.
